Landroid/bluetooth/BluetoothCodecConfig;: sameCodecSpecificParameters: the factory uses Qualcomm codec numbering (4 = aptX Adaptive, 5 = LDAC); Source keeps AOSP numbering (LDAC = 4) because the Source Bluetooth stack is AOSP. References are identical, only the codec constants differ.
Landroid/util/BoostFramework;: The factory creates Smartisan BoostFrameworkSmtBase (mSmtEx/getSmtEx) in every constructor; that Smartisan class loads DPerformance.jar and is part of stage 3.
Landroid/view/View;: onVisibilityAggregated: isAggregatedVisible and gesture-exclusion resend belong to a different upstream change; the content-capture parts are identical.
Landroid/view/ViewRootImpl;: <init>/performDraw: PICO ExtImplFactory creation, mHaveMoveEvent, skip-draw logging and resource IDs (stage 2 hooks and resource layout), not the content-capture port.
Landroid/webkit/WebView;: <init>: PICO mCallback field unrelated to content capture.
Lcom/android/server/UiModeManagerService: onStart/adjustStatusBarCarModeLocked differ only in inlined framework-res resource IDs.
Lcom/android/server/biometrics/face/Face: remove/setFeature/getFeature match up to access$N and lambda numbering; enroll lacks the re-enrollment notification cancel and ENROLL_TIMEOUT_SEC=75, which need later upstream BiometricServiceBase/EnrollClient changes.
Lcom/android/server/locksettings/LockSet: checkCredential: the factory passes an int ChallengeType to doVerifyCredential (separate upstream change); the ported password retention is identical.
Lcom/android/server/wifi/WifiServiceImpl: setWifiEnabled2 carries the PICO wifi_feature_for_customer_enabled check and savePackageControlWifiSate (no donor); getNumConcurrentStaSupported differs only in a framework-res resource ID. The QTI second STA, DPP, getCapabilities and doDriverCmd are ported with the CodeLinaro service (0063, validation/qti-wifi-port.json).
Lcom/android/server/wifi/WifiConfigManag: mergeWithInternalWifiConfiguration also merges the PICO needLogin/autoConnect fields (no donor; the fields exist in the Source WifiConfiguration since 0062).
Lcom/android/bluetooth/btservice/Adapter: getSocketOpt/setSocketOpt/setClockSyncConfig/startClockSync call the QTI vendor stack (libbluetooth_qti) in the factory; the AOSP Source stack returns the donor's failure values (-1/false).
